rationale: All reviewed uses call EASA NPA 2025-07(B) proposed or candidate material and use its lifecycle subjects as a comparison map. The revised manuscript preserves both the non-final status and the hard flight-case boundary; the case graph leaves related evidence planned and obligations open. No artifact promotes the NPA to final AMC/GM, a civil approval, or a completed safety case.
limitations: This does not verify NPA clause wording, later EASA disposition, or current EUROCAE status.
